caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, rendered in a warm, light brown color that evokes the natural tone of polished wood. The chest has a flat top with a slight overhang and a thin decorative molding around the upper edge. The front face is plain except for a large horizontal drawer occupying the lower third, which features two round wooden knobs, one on each side. Above the drawer, there is a small keyhole centered beneath the top edge. The base of the chest has a simple apron with bracket feet at each corner. The background is a plain, solid off-white color, and there are no additional objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Shaker Chest with Drawer
